motion_checks.continuous_basis: Every authored root/ring Y is affine in gather; pleat half-depth is monotone sqrt with fixed segment length. Cloth and tape endpoint X are affine in half-depth; thickness bounded by1.5mm. Fixed rod XZ and moving ring XZ are invariant; tape-to-ring ends are invariant and tape-to-fabric ends share authored coordinates. Full declared envelope avoids all fixed nontrack parts. This is geometric parametrization, not cloth dynamics.
